newsitem.title: MEXICO: CIE stock strong on '96 earnings report.
newsitem.headline: CIE stock strong on '96 earnings report.

text.p: Shares of entertainment company Corporacion Interamericana de Entretenimiento SA de CV (CIE) posted sharp gains in midday trade on Tuesday after reporting 1996 earnings, traders said.
"Earnings were very good. It's a unique company in its field and it has a good outlook for this year," a trader from the Arka brokerage said.
CIE reported earnings of 64.57 million pesos in 1996, compared to 10.10 million pesos in 1995.
CIE B class shares were up one peso to 23.75 pesos.
CIE began trading on the Mexican Stock Exchange in 1996.
